name: dashboard-stats
title: Dashboard stats
description: A row of two to six KPI tiles: label, value, change against a previous period, optional sparkline; with loading skeletons.

frame.summary: KPI tiles are widgets — CLAUDE.md's Card case. An intrinsic grid of Cards.

components.name: select
components.for: Period selector when there are many periods.

components.name: text
components.for: Label (supporting, muted) and value (as large text).

components.name: icon
components.for: Up/down arrow inside the change badge.

dependsOnFuture.interim: Spinner in each tile with an accessible label — heavier but correct.

use: The level the surrounding page gives this block — a template passes it explicitly.
dont: Choosing a level for its visual size. Size is the Heading component's `role`, a separate decision.
headingLevel.a11y: No default, for the reason Heading's `level` has none: only the caller knows the depth, and a skipped level breaks heading navigation for the whole page.

stats.type: Array<{ label: string; value: ReactNode; change?: { value: string; direction: "up" | "down" | "flat"; sentiment: "positive" | "negative" | "neutral" }; href?: string }>

loading.summary: Show skeletons in place of values.

behavior.summary: Static display; loading swaps values for skeletons while keeping labels, so the layout does not shift.

decisions.why: Churn going down is good. Colouring by arrow direction gets it wrong half the time; the caller states which way is good.

decisions.decision: Change is a Badge with text, not colour alone
decisions.why: WCAG 1.4.1: "+12% vs last month" in a success Badge — the subtle-background/fg pairing the token rules require for status text, never the saturated bg.
Six h3s of "Revenue", "Users"… flood the outline; each tile is a list item whose label is read first.

decisions.decision: Sparklines are caller content, not a component
decisions.why: There is no chart component; a sparkline uses color.data.* tokens and must have a text alternative. Flagged as a gap rather than invented.

landmarks.label: aria-labelledby the heading, only when a title is given

obligations: While loading, the list has aria-busy="true".
A sparkline needs a text summary ("rising over 30 days") or aria-hidden plus the change text.

steps.change: One tile per row (two on native phones, where tiles are compact).
Up to the stat count, typically four per row.

native.reason: App block: gets a native version by decision B3. Native is pro tier (decision N6) while the web version stays free; the registry field for that is proposed in docs/platforms.md §3.
native.mapping: A horizontally paged or 2-column grid of stat tiles at the top of a home screen.

tokens.value type: Heading role heading-1 sizing on a non-heading element

tokenGaps.need: A grid gutter role (column and row gap between tiles)
tokenGaps.interim: gap: var(--rata-space-gap-lg) between tiles, var(--rata-space-stack-lg) between rows when they wrap. space.gap.* is documented for inline items, not grid gutters.
Out of scope; color.data.* is the palette for it when one is specified.
